# Mentor Business Consulting - Heavy Freight Logistics & SADC Truck Services

> Premier heavy haulage, superlink truck transport, and cross-border freight services connecting South Africa, Cape Town, Johannesburg, Durban to SADC countries and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC).

## Company Overview
- **Legal & Operating Name**: Mentor Business Consulting
- **Primary Website**: https://mentorconsulting.co.za
- **Headquarters**: Ottery, Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
- **Phone / Dispatch Hotline**: 0605150440 (+27 60 515 0440)
- **WhatsApp Dispatch**: +27 60 515 0440 (https://wa.me/27605150440)
- **Service Availability**: 24 Hours / 7 Days a Week

## Fleet Specifications & Services
- **Superlink Double Trailers (34 Ton Payload)**: Ideal for cross-border FMCG, containerized freight, manufactured goods, and high-volume industrial cargo.
- **Tri-Axle Flatbed Trailers (30 Ton Payload)**: Engineered for open-deck freight, structural steel, timber, construction materials, and heavy pipes.
- **Heavy Duty Lowbed Trailers (50+ Ton Payload)**: Specialized abnormal haulage for mining equipment, earthmoving excavators, bulldozers, and heavy industrial plant machinery.
- **Bulk Side-Tipper Trailers**: Efficient bulk transport for agricultural products, mining minerals, and raw commodities.

## Major Trade Corridors & Border Post Clearance
- **South Africa Interstate Express**: Daily scheduled haulage connecting Cape Town Hub, Gauteng (Johannesburg), KwaZulu-Natal (Durban Port), and Limpopo (Musina border gateway).
- **DRC Highway Line**: Direct heavy haulage line to Lubumbashi, Kolwezi, Likasi, and Kinshasa via Beitbridge (SA/ZIM), Chirundu (ZIM/ZAM), and Kasumbalesa (ZAM/DRC) border posts.
- **SADC Regional Corridors**: Freight runs to Zambia (Lusaka, Ndola), Zimbabwe (Harare), Botswana (Gaborone, Ramatlabama), Mozambique (Maputo, Lebombo), and Namibia (Windhoek).

## Insurance & Security Standards
- **GIT Insurance**: R500,000 to R5,000,000+ Goods-In-Transit insurance coverage included.
- **Real-Time Tracking**: 24/7 satellite GPS tracking and satellite-monitored corridor transit updates.
